title: Aerated Uruguayan Herring Stew
description: A rich and flavorful stew from Uruguay that's quick to make and features herring as the main ingredient. This nut-free-friendly dish is perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: Fish stock
ingredients.notes: chicken or vegetable stock can be used as a substitute

instructions: In a large pot, melt the butter over medium heat. Add the onion and cook until it's translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the herring fillets and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until they're browned.
Add the white wine and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Add the fish stock and diced tomatoes. Stir to combine.
Reduce the heat to low and let the stew simmer for 10-12 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through.
Stir in the heavy cream and let it simmer for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the stew has thickened slightly.
Season the stew with salt, black pepper, and red pepper flakes.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped parsley.
Cover the pot and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
